findings.summary: Closing Help at the mobile breakpoint drops keyboard focus from its guide link to the document body, losing the user’s position.
findings.fix: Before closing #guardian-help, if it contains document.activeElement, focus its summary with preventScroll:true; then apply help.open=desktop.matches.
findings.evidence: Chrome fixture: focused #guardian-help-guide at1280px; resize to390px -> help.open=false and document.activeElement===document.body.

passed: Chrome isolated fixture: all scoped ARIA ID references resolve.
Task links use native anchors; keyboard activation opens applicable details and focuses a visible input, summary or heading.
Native settings and Manage disclosures expose expanded state and accessible names.
Student Settings links select the matching student before opening settings.
Chrome accessible names preserve task label/state boundaries, e.g. 학생 계정 만들기 완료.
Account name and guide link are native DOM text/link, populated with textContent rather than HTML.
Guardian data rendered by new code is limited to owned student/lecture metadata; analysis candidate text is not read or emitted.
notes: Runtime used current source functions in an isolated DOM fixture with mocked read-only student/lecture data; no API calls, authentication or app edits.
Actual VoiceOver/NVDA speech and Safari accessibility navigation were not tested.
